data.title: Thailand targets over 68bn baht in medical investment, with MSD pact planned to expand clinical trials
data.description: An MSD agreement planned for September 9 would expand clinical trials as Thailand pursues drug discounts, technology transfers and local production

data.title: Hong Kong's first post-colonial leader Tung Chee-hwa dies at 89
data.description: HONG KONG - Tung Chee-hwa, Hong Kong's first leader after the city's return to Chinese rule, has died aged 89, his office said on Wednesday.

data.title: Iran attacks US base in Jordan as Hormuz impasse deepens
data.description: TEHRAN - Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on Wednesday they pummelled a US military base in Jordan, vowing retaliation for American strikes on Iranian oil tankers that dragged the foes deeper into war.

data.title: Bangkok Design Week  is now ready for your participation applications
data.description: Set to take place in February next year, the Bangkok Design Week is accepting applications through its Open Call, inviting individuals, creative practitioners, businesses, organisations and other interested parties to become part of the festival.

data.title: 9 Temples To Heaven chosen as Thailand's Oscars entry
data.description: 9 Temples To Heaven, directed by Sompot Chidgasornpongse, has been selected by the National Federation of Motion Pictures and Contents Associations as Thailand's entry for the 99th Academy Awards in the Best International Feature Film category.

data.title: Sounds Of Wireless stages  evening of classical guitarists
data.description: Six guitarists from different generations will deliver their expressive range and versatility during "Sounds Of Wireless: Classical Guitar Conversations – From Solos To Sextet", at 140 Wireless, Witthayu Road, on Saturday at 4pm.

data.title: The golfer who inspired my journey
data.description: Brian Huggett was my inspiration in becoming a professional golfer. When I was a young lad, our paths crossed as his father was the club professional of my local golf course. Brian was a prominent tournament player, winning many tournaments and finish third in the 1962 British Open and second in 1965. He played in many Ryder Cup tournaments and was synonymous with holing, arguably, golf's most pressurised putt when he thought the three feet in front of him was to win the 1969 Ryder Cup outright. He was playing Billy Casper and was thinking that the last match playing behind him was being won by Tony Jacklin, who was playing Jack Nicklaus.

data.title: Aussie Opetaia in Sin City as he chases unfinished business
data.description: Jai Opetaia will take the work from his recent Phuket training camp to one of boxing's biggest stages this weekend when he faces Noel Mikaelian at T-Mobile Arena in Las Vegas.

data.title: PP calls for reform in the House
data.description: The opposition People's Party (PP) has submitted a motion calling for improvements to parliamentary meeting procedures and food services for MPs during late-night sessions, saying lawmakers are often left without food when debates run into the night.

data.title: Courtside pass
data.description: Following a successful WTA 250 tournament -- a tier of women's professional tennis -- in 2025, the Singapore Tennis Open (STO) has been upgraded to a WTA 500 event for the first time in Southeast Asia. This year, the STO will be a WTA 500 event and take place from Sept 21-27 at OCBC Arena at the Singapore Sports Hub in Kallang.

data.title: Proadprans to take over as SAT chief from Oct 1
data.description: The cabinet approved the Ministry of Tourism and Sports' proposal to appoint Proadprans Samarnmit as the governor of the Sports Authority of Thailand, government deputy spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana said on Tuesday.

data.title: Thais refuse to let absences hinder bid
data.description: Thailand's U23 squad continued their preparations on Tuesday for the men's football tournament of the 2026 Asian Games in Japan, with midfielder Thanakrit Chotmuangpak stressing that the absence of two key figures will not derail the team's ambitions.

data.title: Airport Link faces temporary extension
data.description: The current operator of the Airport Rail Link may continue running the service after its memorandum of understanding (MoU) with the State Railway of Thailand (SRT) expires on Sept 30, said Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC) Office secretary-general Chula Sukmanop.

data.title: Campus feud sparks talks
data.description: Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation Minister Yodchanan Wongsawat said he would meet police and deans from two rival campuses after students clashed again at Siam BTS station.

data.title: Ekkapob named new govt spokesman
data.description: The cabinet approved the appointment of Dr Ekkapob Pianpises as a government spokesman yesterday, according to deputy government spokeswoman Lalida Persvivatana.

data.title: KL renews peace talks support
data.description: Malaysia has reaffirmed its commitment to work with Thailand to resolve the long-running southern insurgency, Foreign Affairs Minister Sihasak Phuangketkeow said.

data.title: Blacklist targets civil service cheats
data.description: The government is tightening measures against cheating in civil service examinations, including a nationwide blacklist of offenders and plans to make the General Examination a fully electronic exam within three years.

data.title: Abhisit grills govt on Land Bridge study
data.description: Democrat Party leader Abhisit Vejjajiva has questioned why the government has continued funding a feasibility study of the controversial Land Bridge project, despite the Finance Ministry acknowledging concerns about its economic viability.

data.title: Navy moves ahead  with frigate plan
data.description: The Royal Thai Navy is moving ahead with its frigate procurement project after the permanent secretary for defence approved the selection result, stressing that the project must deliver benefits to Thailand beyond simply acquiring a new warship.

data.title: Real Madrid win Champions League opener as Haaland stars for Man City
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - Jose Mourinho got off to a winning start on his return to the Champions League with Real Madrid on Tuesday as the Spanish giants beat Inter Milan 2-1, while Erling Haaland scored twice in Manchester City's victory at Porto.

data.title: Mums demand answers on death
data.description: Two mothers have sought help from the Pavena Foundation for Children and Women over a 17-year-old girl's death following an alleged assault at a rehabilitation centre in Lampang.

data.title: Phuket MP faces 3rd summons
data.description: The Department of Special Investigation (DSI) has summoned People's Party MP for Phuket Somchart Techathavorncharoen to meet investigators next Monday in an inquiry into alleged foreign nominee arrangements.

data.title: Chinese boxing promoter in legal victory
data.description: The Appeal Court on Tuesday acquitted a Chinese boxing promoter of human trafficking charges, citing inconsistencies and doubts in the evidence against him.

data.title: Thailand, Brazil push for stronger economic ties
data.description: Thailand and Brazil are seeking to deepen their partnership as diplomatic relations approach their 70th anniversary, with trade and investment high on the agenda.

data.title: BJT fears renewed turmoil
data.description: The Bhumjaithai Party (BJT) has hit back at former activist leader Sondhi Limthongkul, warning that renewed street protests could drag Thailand back 20 years and undermine investor confidence.

data.title: Sri Lankan workers get nod
data.description: The government recently approved two memoranda of understanding (MOUs) on labour cooperation between Thailand and Sri Lanka, paving the way for the legal employment of 10,000 Sri Lankan workers in Thailand.
